title: 2-Bromo-6-ethyl-5-[(4-methoxy-3-methylphenyl)sulfonyl]-5,6-dihydrophenanthridin
paragraph: The title compound was prepared from 6-ethyl-5-[(4-methoxy-3-methylphenyl)sulfonyl]-5,6-dihydrophenanthridine and excess bromine according to the procedure and in the same manner as described in Example 19, step a and yielded, after crystallization from a mixture of ethyl acetate-hexane, 2-bromo-6-ethyl-5-[(4-methoxy-3-methylphenyl)sulfonyl]-5,6-dihydrophenanthridine as a colorless, crystalline, solid, which was characterized by LCMS (ES+, FA, CV=5) and 1H NMR;

title: 6-Chloro-3-[ethoxymethylidene]-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridin-2-one
paragraph: This compound was synthesized from 6-chloro-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridin-2-one and diethoxymethyl acetate according to Procedure A. 1H NMR 400 MHz (DMSO-d6): δ 11.06 (s, 1H); 7.84 (s, 1H); 7.63 (d, 1H); 6.98 (d, 1H); 4.39 (m, 2H); 1.32 (m, 3H).

title: 2-tert-Butyl-4-{4-[3-(4-methyl-5-methyl-4H-[1,2,4]triazol-3-ylsulfanyl)-propyl]-piperazin-1-yl}-6-tert-butyl-pyrimidine hydrochloride
paragraph: 1 g of 2-tert-Butyl-4-[4-(3-chloro-propyl)-piperazin-1-yl]-6-tert-butyl-pyrimidine (2.83 mmol), 0.4 g of 4-Methyl-5-methyl-4H-[1,2,4]triazole-3-thiol (3.09 mmol), 0.2 g of lithium-hydroxide (8.35 mmol) and a spatula tip of potassium iodide werde stirred in 20 ml of dimethylformamide for 2 h at 80° C. After addition of water and ethyl acetate, the organic phase was separated and dried over magnesium sulfate. After filtration and evaporation of the solvent, the crude product was purified by column chromatography on silica gel using dichloromethane-methanol (1-6%). Fractions containing the product were combined and the solvent was evaporated. The residue was dissolved in isopropanol, and a solution of HCl in isopropanol was added. On addition of diisopropylethylether, the product formed an oily mass. The solvent was decanted and the remaining oil evaporated to dryness to yield 0.6 g (41%) of the title compound as a white solid.

title: 1-cyclooctylmethylimidazole hydrochloride
paragraph: 1-Cyclooctylmethylimidazole (~0.3 g) was dissolved in dry ether (30 ml), when a stream of dry hydrogen chloride was passed through the solution at -20° C. The resulting white precipitate was filtered off under dry nitrogen and recrystallised from ethyl acetate/petroleum ether (b.p. 40°-60° C.) to afford 1-cyclooctylmethylimidazole hydrochloride as a white solid, m.p. 20°-22° C.

title: 4-(2,3-dimethoxybenzoyl)pyridine
paragraph: In Scheme H, step d, 4-pyridinecarboxylic acid (18) is reacted with lithiated veratrole to give 4-(2,3-dimethoxybenzoyl)pyridine (12).

title: 6-Bromo-7-ethylthieno(2,3-b]pyrazine-2,3(1H,4H)-dione
paragraph: A suspension of 7-ethylthieno[2,3-b]pyrazine-2,3(1H,4H)-dione (1.0 g, 5.1 mmol) and sodium acetate (0.84 g, 10.2 mmol) in 225 ml of acetic acid was stirred at 10°-15° C. under a dry nitrogen atmosphere. A solution of bromine (0.26 ml, 5.1 mmol) in 2 ml of acetic acid was added during 0.5 h. Stirring was continued for further 0.5 h at room temperature and the reaction mixture was poured into ice water. The reddish mixture was decolourized by the addition of a small amount of aqueous sodium dithionite. The precipitate was filtered off, washed with water, resuspended in alcohol, filtered and washed with ether. Drying at 60° C. in vacuo afforded 720 mg (51%) of the title compound. M.p. 295°-297° C. 1H-NMR (DMSO-D6, δ): 1.04 (t, 3H), 2.62 (q, 2H), 12.01 (s, 1H), 12.19 (s, 1H).
